app.title: Choumran — Money Transaction Fraud Detection
app.tagline: Fraud & scam detection for money transactions
lang.label: Language
upload.demo.title: Try it on synthetic data
upload.demo.desc: We generate fake transactions between persons and shops with hidden fraud and scam cases, and the system tries to detect them.
upload.file.title: Upload your data
upload.file.desc: CSV or Excel file. Data is processed in memory only and never saved on the server.
upload.drop: Tap to choose a file, or drag it here
map.title: Column mapping
map.desc: Choose which column of your file matches each field. Fields marked * are required.
opt.train: Train a new model on my file's labels (requires a label column)
opt.custom: Use the last model I trained
schema.title: What should the file contain?
schema.note: Column names don't have to match exactly — you can map them after uploading. The label column (ordinary / fraud / scam) is optional: if present, we compare the model's results against it, or you can train a new model on it.
col.label: Known label (optional, for training)
thr.label: Suspicion threshold (T/F):
thr.help: A transaction is flagged as suspicious when its probability of being fraud or scam is above this threshold. Lowering it catches more cases but raises more false alarms.
g.search: Focus on a person or shop...
g.truncated: · (large network — showing the most important part)
entity.placeholder: Tap any person or shop in the network or the table to see its details.
e.h.name: Name
reason.new_collector: new receiver collecting from many people
feat.receiver_unique_senders: Number of people who paid the receiver
feat.receiver_senders_per_day: Speed of receiver gaining new payers
model.patterns: Which patterns did the model learn?
model.desc: The model (Random Forest) learns the pattern of each kind of transaction: ordinary, fraud (stolen account or card: large spending at night from a new device or city), and scam (a new receiver collecting round amounts from many people who don't know it). Each new transaction is then compared against these patterns.
model.perf: Model performance on test data it didn't see during training
eval.title: Comparison with the labels in your file
eval.none: Your file has no label column, so we can't measure accuracy on it.
loading.demo: Generating and analysing synthetic data... (the first run can take a minute while the model trains)
loading.train: Training a new model on your data...

err.unknown_labels: Unknown label values: {values} (allowed: ordinary / fraud / scam)
err.excel_lib: Reading Excel files requires the openpyxl library
err.not_found: Analysis not found or expired. Please upload the file again.
err.train_needs_label: To train, you must select the label column
